title: C2M Coherence Clusters, JMS Queues & Inbound Web Services (IWS) Configuration
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Oracle Utilities C2M + WebLogic 14c administration; middleware/database/integration work, production-impact care).

Oracle Utilities C2M/CC&B/MDM + WebLogic 14c authored from Oracle's official product + OUAF docs; version-specific details (C2M 25.4/min v2.9, WebLogic 14c) cited or flagged 'verify for your version'; My-Oracle-Support-gated patches/notes are pointed to, not reproduced. Automation is WLST (Jython)/shell/SQL, not PowerShell.
hook: Wire up the C2M runtime: Coherence, JMS, and IWS
problem: C2M's real-time behaviour lives in its runtime components — Coherence clusters, JMS queues, and Inbound Web Services (IWS) — and misconfiguring any of them breaks clustering, messaging, or integration. This solution configures the C2M runtime layer: Coherence cluster setup, JMS queues/topics and connection factories, and IWS deployment — so the platform clusters, messages, and integrates correctly, pilot-first.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the C2M runtime: Coherence clustering, JMS messaging, and Inbound Web Services, and how they support batch, real-time, and integration.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (WebLogic domain, C2M product config, network/ports for Coherence, IWS prerequisites).

Implementation Guide — exact steps to configure the named Coherence cluster, create JMS queues/topics + connection factories, and deploy/enable IWS, then validate clustering, messaging, and web-service calls, pilot-first.

5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (cluster formed, JMS flowing, IWS responding) plus Best Practices for Coherence/JMS/IWS.
short: Configure the C2M runtime — Coherence clusters, JMS queues, and Inbound Web Services (IWS) — so the platform clusters, messages, and integrates correctly, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
